lines.en: label nodokasummer2nightgen:
scene nodokasummer2nightgen
I call Nodoka to find that that she’s taken it upon herself to sneak into the school and spend the night swimming- likely to give herself a break from all of the artistic smut she reads.
lines.zh: 我打电话给 Nodoka，结果发现她自作主张溜进学校，打算在那儿游一晚上的泳——大概是为了从她读的那些艺术色情小说里喘口气。

lines.en: {i}How{/i} she managed to sneak into school, I’m not going to question. Especially since that is something I have been guilty of on several occasions with several other girls.
lines.zh: 她是{i}怎么{/i}溜进学校的，我不打算追问。尤其是这种事我自己也跟好几个女孩干过好几回了。

lines.en: Regardless, I decide to join her there because the only thing better than a night of discussing the ins and outs of sex (Pun not intended) with an attractive girl is discussing that same exact thing while she is half-naked.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我决定过去找她，因为比「跟一个漂亮女孩聊一晚上性事的种种门道（此处非双关）」更棒的，只有她半裸着聊同样的事。

lines.en: Or just having actual sex with her but, given the type of person Nodoka is proving to be and my dramatic lack of Nodoka points, I can’t envision that happening any time soon.
lines.zh: 或者直接跟她上床也行——不过以 Nodoka 目前展现出来的为人，加上我那惨淡的 Nodoka 点数，我想象不出这事儿近期会发生。

lines.en: When I arrive at the pool, I quickly take notice of a certain level of grace I didn’t really expect to see from her as she swims her way over to me and whips the water out of her hair, soaking my t-shirt in the process.
lines.zh: 到了泳池，我立刻注意到她身上有种我没料到的优雅——她游到我身边，把头发里的水一甩，顺带把我的 T 恤也弄湿了。

lines.en: scene black

Feeling generous and not wanting to subject me to the {i}torture{/i} that would be watching her swim for the rest of the night, Nodoka joins me along the side of the pool and takes a seat on the tiles.
lines.zh: Nodoka 大概是发了善心，不忍心让我受「看她游一整晚」这份{i}罪{/i}，便陪我坐到泳池边上的瓷砖上。

lines.en: The scent of chlorine is enjoyably pungent as it rolls off of her skin and onto my clothes each time our shoulders touch.
lines.zh: 氯气的味道浓得恰到好处，每次我们肩膀相碰，那股味儿就从她皮肤上滚到我的衣服上。

lines.en: She speaks the same way she always does, but the silence brought on by night mixed with the water and a room that only emphasizes each and every noise makes her sound unbelievably powerful.
lines.zh: 她说话还是老样子，可夜色带来的寂静，加上水声，加上这间会把每一点声响都放大的房间，让她的声音听起来有种难以置信的力量感。

lines.en: It also makes me feel unbelievably alone...but not in a way that I dislike.
lines.zh: 这也让我感到难以置信的孤独……但不是我讨厌的那种孤独。

lines.en: Right now, this is the only world that exists to us.
lines.zh: 此刻，这就是我们唯一存在的世界。

lines.en: And I finally understand why Nodoka may have wanted to spend her time here rather than in a world with everyone else.
lines.zh: 我终于明白，Nodoka 为什么会想待在这里，而不是待在有其他所有人的那个世界里。
